newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Queensland reach final as Tasmania thwarted.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Queensland reach final as Tasmania thwarted.

text.p: Queensland on Sunday came from third place to secure a spot in the Sheffield Shield final against Western Australia after a desperate run chase which saw New South Wales defeat second-placed Tasmania.

Queensland began the final day of its match against South Australia locked on 22 points in the Shield standings with New South Wales and needed just seven balls to complete a 137-run victory over last-placed South Australia at the Gabba ground.
The Queenslanders then endured an anxious seven-hour wait for the outcome of the match at the Sydney Cricket Ground, which Tasmania had to win to reach their first Shield final.
